intro: A selection lines quizzes up to launch them into a room in one go: after each quiz, the room’s lobby picks the next one. Shared, other hosts can present it or create their own from it.
empty: Create one to line up the quizzes of a session, or save a room as a selection from its console.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete this selection?
deleteConfirm.description: “{{name}}” is deleted; its quizzes and the results of its launches stay.

notFound: This selection does not exist, or is not shared with you.
name: Name of the selection
descriptionPlaceholder: What it is for, who it is for (optional)
sharedLabel: Share with the instance’s other hosts
sharedHelp: They see it among their selections, read-only: they can present it — the quizzes shared with them, keeping nothing — or create their own from it. Its quizzes are not shared with it.
unsharedWarning_one: {{count}} of its quizzes is not shared: they will not see it.
unsharedWarning_other: {{count}} of its quizzes are not shared: they will not see them.
addQuizDescription: One of your quizzes, or one shared with you. Each quiz once.
noQuiz: Add the quizzes to play, in the order the room plays them.
noLaunch: No launch kept yet: each time you present it and keep the results, it shows here.
readOnlyNotice: {{owner}}’s selection: you can present it or create your own from it, not change it.
